title: Gerunds and Infinitives
summary: إمتى نستخدم الفعل بـ -ing وإمتى to + فعل، والأفعال اللي معناها بيتغيّر زي stop و remember و try.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: A **gerund** is a verb + **-ing** that works like a **noun** (Swimming is good for you). An **infinitive** is **to + base verb** (to learn). Some verbs are followed by a gerund, some by an infinitive, and some by both, sometimes with a change in meaning.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن سؤال بيتكرر كتير: لما فعلين ييجوا ورا بعض، التاني يبقى **-ing** ولا **to + فعل**؟ مثلًا: She enjoys **painting** بس She wants **to learn**.

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 2: Leisure Time**، جزء **Gerunds & Infinitives: Form, Use, and Meaning** (صفحة 51)، والتدريب في **Grammar in Context** (صفحة 52)، وبعدها في **Consolidation Review A**. وكمان الكتاب بيطلب منك تستخدمهم في **opinion paragraph** عن الـ screen time والهوايات.
الفكرة ببساطة

text: Gerund = verb + -ing used as a noun. Infinitive = to + base verb. The **first verb** decides which form comes after it.

blocks.text: الـ **gerund** شكله زي الفعل بـ ing بس **شغله اسم**. يعني تقدر تحط مكانه كلمة زي «الرياضة» أو «الرسم». بالعربي زي **المصدر**: «**السباحة** مفيدة» = **Swimming** is good for you.
الـ **infinitive** هو **to + الفعل في المصدر** (to go, to learn). غالبًا بيبيّن **حاجة عايز تعملها أو ناوي عليها** في المستقبل: «عايز **أتعلم**» = I want **to learn**.
مفيش قاعدة واحدة تحكم كل الأفعال. **الفعل الأول هو اللي بيحدد**، فلازم **تحفظ** القوايم. بس فيه حيلة هتساعدك:

blocks.title: حيلة للفهم
items: الـ **-ing** غالبًا مع حاجة **بتعملها فعلًا أو عملتها** (تجربة): enjoy painting، finish reading، avoid going.
الـ **to** غالبًا مع حاجة **لسه هتحصل** (هدف أو نية): want to go، hope to visit، decide to start، plan to do.

blocks.text: إمتى نستخدم الـ Gerund؟

text: Use a gerund: (1) as the **subject** of a sentence, (2) after **certain verbs**, (3) after **prepositions**, (4) after **go** for activities, (5) after some expressions.

rows: enjoy, avoid, suggest, consider, practise, finish, imagine, mind, keep, give up, can't stand
at, in, of, about, by, for, without, before, after, instead of…
look forward to, be used to, it's worth, there's no point in
I **look forward to meeting** the team.

blocks.text: قايمة الأفعال اللي بعدها **-ing** (من الكتاب + زيادات مهمة):

rows: Try to avoid **using** your phone in bed.
The coach suggested **taking** a short break.
Imagine **living** without screens for a week!
Do you mind **turning** the music down?
He gave up **playing** video games at night.
I can't stand **sitting** still for hours.

blocks.text: إمتى نستخدم الـ Infinitive؟

text: Use **to + base verb**: (1) after **certain verbs**, (2) after **adjectives**, (3) to show **purpose** (why), (4) after **too / enough**, (5) after **verb + person** (ask someone to…).

rows: want, hope, decide, plan, choose, agree, manage, refuse, promise, learn, need, offer, expect, afford
happy, easy, difficult, important, ready, shy…
He joined the choir **to improve** his voice.
She was **too shy to perform**. He is **old enough to choose**.
ask, tell, encourage, allow, want, advise, remind
My parents **encouraged me to join** the club.

blocks.text: قايمة الأفعال اللي بعدها **to** (من الكتاب + زيادات مهمة):

rows: I hope **to visit** the Egyptian Museum.
He decided **to stop** gaming after midnight.
We plan **to do** a cycling trip.
Many teens choose **to stay** at home.
My friend agreed **to help** me train.
He promised **to limit** his screen time.
Children learn **to share** in team sports.
Students can't afford **to lose** sleep before exams.

blocks.text: أفعال بييجي بعدها الاتنين

text: Some verbs (**like, love, hate, prefer, begin, start**) take both forms with little or no change in meaning. Others (**stop, remember, forget, regret, try**) change their meaning.

blocks.text: **أ) من غير تغيير في المعنى:** like / love / hate / prefer / begin / start

items.en: I **like reading** novels. = I **like to read** novels.
It **started raining**. = It **started to rain**.

blocks.text: **ب) المعنى بيتغيّر (مهم جدًا وبييجي كتير):**

rows: stop + ing = **يبطّل** الحاجة. stop + to = **يقف علشان** يعمل حاجة.
+ ing = **فاكر حاجة حصلت** في الماضي. + to = **ماتنساش تعمل** حاجة (مستقبل).
+ ing = مش هنسى حاجة **حصلت**. + to = **نسي يعمل** حاجة.
We regret **to tell** you that the trip is cancelled.
+ ing = **ندمان على** حاجة عملتها. + to = **يؤسفني إني أقول** (رسمي).
+ ing = **جرّب** الحاجة وشوف هتنفع ولا لأ. + to = **حاول** (بمجهود).

blocks.title: حيلة لـ stop / remember / forget
blocks.text: **-ing = بيبص لورا** (حاجة حصلت أو كانت بتحصل). **to = بيبص لقدّام** (حاجة لسه هتتعمل).
حروف الجر والـ to الخادعة

text: After a **preposition** we always use a gerund. Be careful: in **look forward to**, **be used to** and **object to**, "to" is a preposition, so we use **-ing**.

blocks.text: أي **حرف جر** (at, in, of, about, by, for, without, before, after, instead of, despite) بعده **-ing** على طول. وخلي بالك: فيه تعبيرات فيها **to** بس الـ to دي **حرف جر**، فبعدها **-ing** برضه.

items.en: He is talented **at painting**.
She is interested **in learning** photography.
**Instead of scrolling**, try reading a book.
items.ar: بدل ما تفضل تقلّب في الموبايل.

items.en: He joined the orchestra **despite being** nervous.
**Before sleeping**, put your phone in another room.
I'm looking forward **to meeting** my new teammates.
items.ar: ✗ to meet ← ✓ to **meeting**. الـ to هنا حرف جر.

items.en: She is used **to waking** up early for training.
items.ar: متعودة. ✗ used to wake (دي معناها «كانت زمان»).

blocks.text: أمثلة من موضوعات الوحدة
الأمثلة دي عن موضوعات Unit 2: الـ screen time، الفنون والإبداع، الرياضة، وتجربة الخروج في الطبيعة.

items.en: **Spending** time in nature can reduce stress.
items.ar: gerund فاعل: قضاء الوقت في الطبيعة.

items.en: Many teenagers avoid **taking** breaks from their screens.
The coach suggested **doing** a warm-up before the match.
Salma decided **to join** the school orchestra.
I finally managed **to keep up** with my friend on the bike.
At one point, he seriously considered **giving up**.
items.ar: consider + ing. من القصة اللي في الكتاب.

items.en: She paints **to express** her feelings.
It is difficult **to put** your phone away when it keeps buzzing.
My parents encouraged me **to try** pottery.
Stop **checking** your phone every five minutes!
On his way home, Karim stopped **to buy** some water.
I remember **feeling** proud when I crossed the finish line.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ The coach suggested **to go** for a run. ← ✓ The coach suggested **going** for a run.
✗ He enjoys **to paint**. ← ✓ He enjoys **painting**.
✗ Nour decided **joining** the orchestra. ← ✓ Nour decided **to join** the orchestra.
✗ She is good at **draw**. ← ✓ She is good at **drawing**. (بعد حرف الجر ing)
✗ I look forward to **see** you. ← ✓ I look forward to **seeing** you.
✗ He joined the club **for improve** his fitness. ← ✓ He joined the club **to improve** his fitness. (الهدف بـ to)
✗ My father wants **that I study** medicine. ← ✓ My father wants **me to study** medicine.
✗ **Play** sports is healthy. ← ✓ **Playing** sports is healthy. (الفاعل gerund)
✗ Let's **to go** swimming. ← ✓ Let's **go** swimming. (بعد let's فعل من غير to)

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: بص على **الكلمة اللي قبل الفراغ** على طول: فعل؟ افتكر قايمته. حرف جر؟ **ing** على طول. صفة؟ غالبًا **to**.
الجملة بتقول **علشان**؟ يبقى **to + base**.
لو الفعل stop / remember / forget / try / regret: اسأل نفسك **بيبص لورا ولا لقدّام**؟
لو الفراغ في **أول الجملة** كفاعل: **-ing**.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

text: Teenagers often enjoy ______ short videos before bed.
a. watch   b. watching   c. to watching   d. watched

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b. watching.** ليه؟ enjoy بعده **-ing** دايمًا.
**2) Complete with the correct form (gerund or infinitive).**

text: I remember (visit) ______ the pyramids with my school when I was ten.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: visiting.** ليه؟ «when I was ten» يعني الحاجة **حصلت خلاص** وأنا فاكرها ← remember + ing.

**3) Write an opinion paragraph using gerunds and infinitives.** الكتاب بيطلب فقرة رأي من **150-180 كلمة** فيها على الأقل **فعلين + gerund** و**فعلين + infinitive** و**فعل معناه بيتغيّر**. شوف النموذج ده:

blocks.title: Opinion paragraph with gerunds and infinitives
blocks.task: Do you think young people today spend too much time on screens and not enough time on creative or physical activities? Write an opinion paragraph of 150-180 words. Include verbs + gerunds, verbs + infinitives and at least one verb whose meaning changes.
text: In my opinion, many young people today spend too much time on screens and not enough time on creative or physical activities. This is because phones make it very easy **to keep scrolling** for hours. A lot of teenagers **enjoy watching** short videos, but they often **avoid going** out or **trying** something new. For example, my cousin used to sit in front of his laptop all weekend. Last summer, his parents **encouraged him to join** a football team. At first, he refused **to go**, but after a few weeks he **started to love** the training. He even **decided to switch** off his phone during meals. I **remember seeing** him smile after his first goal, and I realised that real activities give us something screens cannot. Of course, screens are useful for **learning** and **keeping** in touch with friends. However, we need **to find** a balance. In conclusion, I strongly believe that young people should **stop spending** every free hour online and **choose to create**, move and connect in the real world.
notes: **Opinion (Claim):** أول جملة بتقول الرأي بوضوح بـ In my opinion.
**Reason:** This is because… + it is easy **to** keep (صفة + to).
**Verbs + gerunds:** enjoy watching / avoid going / stop spending.
**Verbs + infinitives:** refused to go / decided to switch / need to find / choose to create.
**Verb + person + to:** encouraged him to join.
**فعل معناه بيتغيّر:** remember seeing (فاكر حاجة حصلت) و stop spending (يبطّل).
**Example / Evidence:** قصة الـ cousin مثال واقعي، وبعدها رأي الطرف التاني (screens are useful) وده بيقوّي الفقرة.
**Conclusion:** In conclusion… بيعيد الرأي بكلام مختلف، زي ما الكتاب بيطلب.

blocks.text: تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. Yara has decided ______ a photography course this summer.
a. taking  b. took  c. to take  d. take

2. The doctor suggested ______ less time on social media.
a. to spend  b. spending  c. spend  d. spent

3. ______ in a team teaches us to cooperate.
a. Play  b. To playing  c. Played  d. Playing
items.a: **d. Playing** — gerund فاعل في أول الجملة.

items.q:
4. She is very skilled at ______ her emotions through poetry.
a. express  b. to express  c. expressing  d. expressed
items.a: **c. expressing** — بعد حرف الجر at ← ing.

items.q:
5. Ali went to the sports club ______ his fitness.
a. for improving  b. to improve  c. improving  d. improve

6. I'm really looking forward to ______ the Grand Egyptian Museum.
a. visit  b. visiting  c. visited  d. be visiting

7. Please remember ______ your phone before the lesson.
a. switching off  b. to switch off  c. switch off  d. switched off
items.a: **b. to switch off** — ماتنساش تعمل حاجة لسه هتحصل ← to.

items.q:
8. Karim was too tired ______ the race.
a. finishing  b. finish  c. to finish  d. finished

blocks.text: **B. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
9. a. The nurse recommended to drink more water during the match.
b. The nurse recommended drinking more water during the match.
c. The nurse recommended drink more water during the match.
d. The nurse recommended drank more water during the match.

10. a. My parents want that I spend less time online.
b. My parents want me spending less time online.
c. My parents want me to spend less time online.
d. My parents want me spend less time online.

11. a. He gave up to play games at night.
b. He gave up playing games at night.
c. He gave up play games at night.
d. He gave up for playing games at night.

12. a. Instead of watch TV, she went cycling.
b. Instead of to watch TV, she went cycling.
c. Instead of watching TV, she went to cycling.
d. Instead of watching TV, she went cycling.
items.a: **d** — instead of + ing، و go + ing من غير to.

blocks.text: **C. Complete with the correct form (gerund or infinitive) of the verb in brackets.**

items.q: 13. Stop (check) ______ your phone as soon as you wake up.
14. During the bike ride, we stopped (drink) ______ some water in the shade.
15. I'll never forget (cycle) ______ along the Nile at sunrise.
items.a: **cycling** — حاجة حصلت ومش هنساها ← forget + ing.

items.q: 16. If you can't sleep, try (read) ______ a paper book instead of using your phone.
items.a: **reading** — جرّب الحاجة دي وشوف هتنفع ← try + ing.

items.q: 17. We hope (create) ______ a school art exhibition next term.
18. Many teenagers can't imagine (live) ______ without the internet.

blocks.text: **D. Find the mistake and correct it, then write as asked.**

items.q: 19. Find and correct the mistake: He is interested in learn the guitar.
20. Find and correct the mistake: I regret to stay up so late before the exam.
items.a: regret **staying** — ندمان على حاجة عملتها خلاص ← ing.

items.q: 21. Find and correct the mistake: The trainer encouraged us practise every day.
items.a: encouraged us **to practise** — فعل + شخص + to.

items.q: 22. Explain the difference: (a) I stopped eating sweets. (b) I stopped to eat a snack.
items.a: (a) **بطّلت** آكل حلويات. (b) **وقفت** (اللي كنت بعمله) **علشان** آكل سناك.

items.q: 23. Write two sentences about your free time: one with a verb + gerund and one with a verb + infinitive.
items.a: مثال: I **enjoy drawing** comics at the weekend. Next month, I **plan to enter** a drawing competition.

items.q: 24. Write one sentence using 'to' to show purpose about sport.
items.a: مثال: I go running every morning **to clear** my mind before school. — to = علشان.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **-ing (gerund):** فاعل في أول الجملة، بعد **حروف الجر**، وبعد enjoy, avoid, suggest, consider, practise, finish, imagine, mind, keep, give up.
**to + base:** بعد want, hope, decide, plan, choose, agree, manage, refuse، بعد **الصفات**، للـ **هدف** (علشان)، و**فعل + شخص + to**.
**like / love / hate / prefer / begin / start:** الاتنين صح.
**stop / remember / forget / regret / try:** المعنى بيتغيّر. ing = **لورا**، to = **لقدّام**.
**look forward to / be used to** + **ing** (الـ to حرف جر).
